summary: Bug-fix verification for 'Unhandled rejection 401' in LotNeeti. Ran Playwright flow capturing pageerror + console across all required scenarios: (a) logged-out visit to '/' cleanly redirects to /login, (b) demo-credentials login works, (c) navigated Dashboard/Investors/Banks/IPOs/Planner/Applications/Funds, (d) Logout then reload of protected /applications redirects to /login. Also exercised Refresh Live GMP, auto-allocate, lock-plan, and Excel export. RESULT: 0 pageerrors, 0 unhandled promise rejections, 0 uncaught console messages across the entire session. The only console entries are expected network-level '401' resource warnings for pre-login /api/auth/me (fully swallowed by the axios interceptor + .catch handlers) — these are browser-level log lines, not JS runtime errors or unhandled rejections. Excel download succeeded (ipo_applications.xlsx).

critical_code_review_comments: Network-level '401 ()' lines still appear in browser console for /api/auth/me on logged-out load. They are harmless (caught) but could be suppressed by probing session via a dedicated /auth/session endpoint or by not calling /auth/me when no session cookie indicator exists, to keep devtools clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug 'Unhandled rejection 401' is fully resolved. Axios response interceptor in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js correctly redirects to /login on 401 for non-auth routes; AuthContext /auth/me has .catch; all page fetches have .catch. If re-testing, watch pageerror + console 'Unhandled/Uncaught' only — plain '401 ()' resource log lines are expected network traces, not errors.
